# Davide Testuggine

> Davide Testuggine is a research engineer working on LLM post-training, reinforcement learning, and agentic systems. He led post-training for Llama 3.0, led the team behind Llama Guard, and co-created OpenEnv, an open standard for RL environments.

This file is a plain map of https://testuggine.ninja/ for AI agents and tools. Every page linked here is public.

## Pages

- [About](https://testuggine.ninja/about/): background and selected work.
- [Writing](https://testuggine.ninja/writing/): posts and articles.
- [Talks](https://testuggine.ninja/talks/): recorded talks with video.
- [Publications](https://testuggine.ninja/publications/): selected papers.
- [RSS feed](https://testuggine.ninja/index.xml)

## Writing

- [A primer on LLM post-training](https://pytorch.org/blog/a-primer-on-llm-post-training/): August 2025, PyTorch blog.
- [Differential privacy, part 3: per-sample gradients for more layers](https://pytorch.medium.com/differential-privacy-series-part-3-efficient-per-sample-gradient-computation-for-more-layers-in-39bd25df237): November 2022, PyTorch on Medium.
- [Differential privacy, part 2: efficient per-sample gradients in Opacus](https://medium.com/pytorch/differential-privacy-series-part-2-efficient-per-sample-gradient-computation-in-opacus-5bf4031d9e22): September 2021, PyTorch on Medium.
- [Differential privacy, part 1: DP-SGD explained](https://medium.com/pytorch/differential-privacy-series-part-1-dp-sgd-algorithm-explained-12512c3959a3): August 2020, PyTorch on Medium.
